description: Adds (or with a negative number subtracts) N business days to a date, skipping weekends and observed U.S. federal or Federal Reserve holidays exactly. The start date is not counted. With 0, returns the start date if it is a business day, otherwise the next one. Lists every holiday skipped.

business_days.description: Business days to add; negative to go back.

calendar.description: federal = OPM observance for federal employees (Saturday holiday -> Friday off). fed_banking = Federal Reserve Banks (Saturday holiday -> open Friday; Sunday -> closed Monday). Use fed_banking for ACH, wire and bank settlement dates.

extra_closed_dates.description: Extra closed dates to treat as holidays, e.g. a one-off executive order closure such as 2025-01-09.

include_inauguration_day.description: federal calendar only: also close Inauguration Day (DC-area federal employees only, every 4 years).

name: add_business_days
title: Add or subtract U.S. business days
